headline: Curated antibody and TCR databases add ML-ready structures and specificity profiles
label: Curated Biomolecular Structure Resources
summary: Recent releases pair ML-grade antibody structures with versioned train/test splits and interactive TCR specificity profiles.
synthesis: The common thread is curated resources that attach experimental annotation to biomolecular structures or sequence-level specificity data. SAbDab2 updates the antibody structure database for new antibody formats, offering ML-grade structures and versioned train/test splits. The TCR Motif Atlas catalogs specificity profiles for hundreds of viral, cancer, and autoimmune epitopes, with an interactive tool for building profiles. Separately, an AlphaFold 3 study applies structure prediction to more than 9000 TCRs across over 1000 epitopes, reporting median AUCs of 0.81-0.92. DeepPhage, an open-source command-line tool for phage display NGS data, is related but distinct, focusing on Eu3+-binding peptide identification. What is new is versioned partitioning for ML use attached directly to antibody structures, alongside specificity profiles built interactively.
